title: World App 3.0 introduces Vault
description: World announced World App 3.0 with a Vault feature that let users earn rewards on assets held through the app.
notes: The launch establishes the user-facing Vault era. It does not prove that every Vault asset used one identical yield mechanism.

title: Morpho Mini App brings lending and vault rewards into World App
description: World launched a Morpho Mini App for World App, giving users access to Morpho-powered lending, borrowing and vault rewards on World Chain.
notes: Morpho is modeled separately as cya_plat_000140. This event records the historically significant World-side distribution/access layer.

title: Earn replaces the WLD and USDC Vaults in World Money
description: World documented that Earn replaced the legacy WLD and USDC Vaults. Legacy users can move balances into Earn or back to spending, while current Earn uses Morpho-selected on-chain lending protocols.
notes: This is a product/mechanism migration, not a platform failure. The legacy USDC Dollar Vault used Sky/sDAI; CYA does not generalize that mechanism to the historical WLD Vault.
